objectives: To aid patient counseling, enhance shared decision-making and evaluation of HRQoL outcomes, the main objective of this systematic review and meta-analysis was to pool PANQOL HRQoL outcomes in patients with vestibular schwannoma managed with wait-and-scan (W&S), stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS), or microsurgery (MS), and secondarily to compare and evaluate the differences.
inclusion_criteria: Included studies were original, peer-reviewed studies evaluating at least one management strategy (W&S, SRS, or MS) in patients with unilateral sporadic vestibular schwannoma, either as the investigated population or as a subpopulation, and reporting PANQOL total and/or domain scores as outcomes. The majority of patients had to be evaluated with a per-protocol analysis. Follow-up had to be at least 1 year after diagnosis for W&S and at least 1 year after SRS or MS treatment. Articles had to have full-text availability and be written in English or Dutch.
exclusion_criteria: Excluded were studies including patients with neurofibromatosis type II, salvage treatment, or combinations of treatments; literature reviews or systematic reviews, meta-analyses, case reports, comments, letters to the editor, and books; and studies from which PANQOL data were not extractable from the text, tables, or supplementary files.
pmid_query: PubMed search (Appendix 1): (("neuroma, acoustic"[MeSH Terms:noexp] OR "acoustic neuroma*"[tiab] OR "acoustic schwannoma*"[tiab] OR "schwannoma, acoustic"[tiab] OR "neurinoma of the acoustic nerve*"[tiab] OR "acoustic neurilemoma*"[tiab] OR "vestibular schwannoma*"[tiab] OR "Schwannoma, Vestibular"[tiab] OR "acoustic tumor*"[tiab] OR "acoustic tumour*"[tiab] OR "acoustic neurilemmoma*"[tiab] OR "acoustic neurinoma*"[tiab]) AND ("Quality of Life"[Mesh] OR "quality of life"[tiab] OR life qualit*[tiab] OR living qualit*[tiab] OR "quality of living"[tiab] OR "qol"[tiab] OR "hrql"[tiab] OR "hrqol"[tiab])) OR ("PANQOL"[Text Word] OR "Penn Acoustic Neuroma Quality Of Life"[Text Word]). The review searched PubMed and Embase through February 10, 2025, with studies restricted to 2010 onward.
selection_evidence: The main Results/Study selection section reports 973 potentially eligible records, 614 unique articles screened, 66 full-text reviews, and 16 included studies, citing them as [4, 6, 13, 24-36]. The same 16 references are independently recoverable from the main-text risk-of-bias split: moderate risk [4, 6, 13, 25-27, 32, 34, 36] and serious risk [24, 28-31, 33, 35]. Appendix 3 study-characteristics tables list 12 W&S studies, 9 SRS studies, and 12 MS studies whose unique author-year entries map to these same 16 references. The manuscript also explicitly states that Link et al. 2018 [37] was excluded for overlapping population/outcomes, with Carlson et al. 2015 [6] retained instead.
notes: Main-text OCR renders the inclusion citation unclearly as [4, 6, 13, 24...6], but Appendix 2 and Appendix 3 confirm that the intended inclusive range is 24-36. Supplemental study-characteristics tables show minor year-label inconsistencies versus the reference list for some studies (for example, Lucidi listed as 2021 in Appendix 3 but ref 29 is 2022; Pruijn listed as 2020 in Appendix 3 but ref 4 is 2021), but the numbered reference set itself is stable. Git was unavailable in this environment, so staged-file status could not be queried separately; conclusions are based on the current files present under the target directory and supplemental folder.
